fact: The pilot phase of Angola's Cadastro Social Unico began in Sumbe municipality, Cuanza-Sul, registering households, with the minister saying the first operational stage will inform progressive national expansion (Angop).

Angola's Ministry of Social Action opened the pilot launch of the Cadastro Social Unico in Sumbe, Cuanza-Sul, training 79 participants on the platform, to test the methodology before progressive expansion to other provinces (Angop).
ANGOP reports the Ministry of Social Action launched the Cadastro Social Único platform, a centralised database to manage and target social support, in the week ending 25 July 2026.
MASFAMU reports the First Lady symbolically activated the Cadastro Social Único platform on 20 July 2026, the registry instituted by Presidential Decree 136/19 of 10 May.

ANGOP reports the Ministry of Social Action launched the Cadastro Social Único on 20 July 2026, with teams to register households using digital tools, collecting socioeconomic data with biometrics and facial recognition.

The World Bank ISR says 1,595,496 households were registered in the social registry by 30 June 2024, as part of the cash transfer roll-out in the target municipalities, while the unified registry (CSU) was not yet operational.
